premises: For a smooth integral projective variety X over an algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field of arbitrary cardinality, every numerical class θ has the envelope property. For every pseudoeffective θ, V_θ=P_θ(0) is genuine θ-psh, has supremum and generic value zero, and the supremum-zero genuine θ-psh cone is compact in the divisorial topology. [BJ Addendum, Theorem A and Corollaries 2.1–2.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.07183v2).

For a projective variety Y of dimension d over an uncountable algebraically closed field and any big Cartier divisor A, the full section asymptotic is a limit: lim_(m→∞) d! h^0(Y,mA)/m^d=vol_Y(A), with volume initially defined by the limsup. [Lazarsfeld–Mustaţă, Proposition 2.1, Lemma 2.2 and Theorem 2.3](https://www.math.stonybrook.edu/robert.lazarsfeld/Reprints/Laz.Mustata.CBALS.pdf).

For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme Y over a field k, a quasi-coherent sheaf F, and a field extension K/k, the natural map H^0(Y,F)⊗_k K→H^0(Y_K,F_K) is an isomorphism. [Stacks, flat base change](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02KH).

For a smooth integral projective d-fold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, divisor volume is continuous on N^1_R, vanishes outside the big cone, equals the top positive product on the big cone, and its dth root is concave there. [BFJ, Theorems 2.16, 3.1 and 3.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0608260v2).

For a smooth integral projective d-fold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, volume is C1 on the big cone, with Dvol_α(H)=d⟨α^(d−1)⟩·H for every real Cartier direction H. [BFJ, Theorem A](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0608260v2).

Over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, positive products of big Cartier classes on the Riemann–Zariski space of a projective variety are homogeneous, continuous, and increasing in each variable for the pseudoeffective Cartier order, and produce compatible pseudoeffective Weil classes. [BFJ, §§2.2–2.3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0608260v2).

Over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, the Riemann–Zariski pairing of a nef Cartier divisor with a pseudoeffective Weil curve class on a projective variety is nonnegative and compatible with birational pullback and pushforward. [BFJ, Remark 2.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0608260v2).

For projective X over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, X^an is compact Hausdorff. Rational model functions form a lattice containing rational constants, are uniformly dense in C0(X^an), and identify with vertical rational Cartier divisors modulo pullback. On an integrally closed test configuration, f_D≥0 iff D≥0; at a central component E, f_D(v_E)=ord_E(D)/ord_E(t), with v_E divisorial or generic. [BJ, §§1.4 and 2.1–2.2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1801.08229v4).

For a projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued field and an actual ample line bundle A, every divisorial valuation v has finite maximal section vanishing order T_A(v)=sup_(m,s≠0) m^(-1)v(s). [BJ, Proposition 1.28](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1801.08229v4).

Every reduced noetherian quasi-excellent Q-scheme Y with a nowhere dense closed subset Z admits a projective birational resolution with regular source, simple-normal-crossings inverse image of Z, isomorphic outside Z∪Y_sing, functorial for surjective regular morphisms of pairs. [Abramovich–Temkin, §2.2 and Theorem 2.2.10](https://msp.org/ant/2019/13-2/ant-v13-n2-p04-p.pdf).
Every Noetherian normal domain R equals the intersection of its height-one localizations R_p inside its fraction field. [Stacks, Lemma 10.157.6](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/031T).
